patterns.note: A prominent split-screen layout is used, with a fixed right panel displaying full-bleed imagery and a scrollable left panel containing all textual content and interactive elements.
Oversized, decorative serif typography is used for main section headings, creating a strong visual statement, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A vibrant teal/aqua color serves as the primary accent, used for branding, large headings, and interactive elements, set against a soft, warm cream background.
The fixed right panel dynamically changes its full-bleed background image or scene as the user scrolls down the left content panel, providing contextual visuals for each section.
Each major content section is introduced by a very large, decorative serif heading that acts as a strong visual anchor and clearly delineates content areas.

technique_notes: A two-column grid layout is implemented where the right column is fixed to the viewport, while the left column is independently scrollable to reveal content.

The fixed right column acts as a dynamic visual backdrop, with its background imagery transitioning or swapping based on the scroll position of the left content column. This effect is likely achieved using scroll-triggered events (e.g., GSAP ScrollTrigger) that map specific content sections to corresponding image or video changes in the fixed panel.
Large, decorative serif typefaces are employed for prominent section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy and contributing significantly to the brand's unique identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, decorative serif headings (approximately 5-6x body text size) create a strong visual statement, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for all other content.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; interactive elements and image containers feature a very slight corner rounding, almost appearing sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks contributes to an uncrowded and relaxed feel, particularly around large headings.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the split-screen layout where the right panel remains fixed and dynamically changes its full-bleed background image in response to the user's scroll depth on the left content panel. This creates a unique, immersive, and visually engaging browsing experience that feels more like an interactive editorial piece than a typical website.
